questions.question_en: Did Samuel help Eli in the house of God?
Did God call Samuel's name at night?
Did Samuel know it was God calling the very first time?
questions.question_ko: 사무엘은 처음부터 그것이 하나님인 줄 알았나요?
questions.feedback_en: No, Eli helped him understand after it happened three times!
questions.feedback_ko: 아니에요, 세 번이나 반복된 후에야 엘리가 알아차리게 도와주었어요!
